王野一路疾驰，进了平三卓家的院子就喊道：“师娘～师娘救命呀，我师父，和我大师兄要揍我。”

师娘听见王野的喊声，穿着围裙拿着铲子就出来了。王野赶紧上前诉苦道：“师娘，你可要救救我呀！”

师娘焦急的问：“怎么回事儿啊？跟师娘说说，师娘给你评理，他个老东西，好好的日子是不想好好过了！”

王野添油加醋的把事情的经过说了一遍，师娘哼了一声：“哼～小野没事儿啊，师娘给你做主，那爷俩要是回来了还敢炸毛，你看我怎么收拾他们。”

王野刚告完黑状，平三卓和扎着脑袋的程启铭就进院了。一进院，师娘就开始发飙了：“老大，听说你要动家法？我怎么不知道你们还有什么家法呀？来，来，来把你的家法拿出来，我看看是你的家法硬，还是我的铲子硬？”

程启铭现在也想不通了，这个小师弟以前不这样呀，刚认识的时候挺懂事儿的呀！这是中什么邪了，怎么变得这么滑头了。但是面对师娘的质问，程启铭只能吃哑巴亏：“师娘，我就是吓唬吓唬小师弟，我俩开玩笑呢！”

“开玩笑？有这么开玩笑的吗？你看给小野吓得，一点大师兄的样都没有，我看你就是吃饱撑得。等哪天有空了，我得好好跟程家嫂子念叨念叨。”

程启铭脸都白了，先不说他打不打的过王野，这动不动就叫家长是不是不太好呀，再说了，程启铭的孩子比王野都小不了几岁。这要是让他娘揍一顿，这张老脸也可以不用要了。

程启铭低着脑袋，半天从嘴里憋出一句话：“师娘，以后我不敢了。”

平三卓一句话也没说，就要往屋里走，师娘的威风还没耍够呢，哪能让他这么轻易就蒙混过去：“老东西，你跑什么？听说你很威风呀！小野来看你还看出毛病了，人家孩子昨天下午才回来，今天一早就来看你了。”

“你进屋看看，人家孩子又给你拿肉，又给你拿人参的，你还挑上理了。我看呀，你就是吃饱撑得，干脆以后伙食减半吧。”

这可是赤裸裸的威胁了，平三卓家伙食还算不错，但也就是七八分饱，一周能见点儿荤腥。这已经超过百分之九十五的人家了，这要是减半，小老头真能饿的天天在躺椅上歇着。

平三卓明智的没有顶嘴，他可是太了解自己老伴儿的脾气了。这小老太太真能说的出做的到，真到那时就晚了。见平三卓不说话，师娘也没继续发飙，转身就要回厨房去。

程启铭上前一步小声的说道：“小野，你别忘了，你刚有事儿求我呢！”

王野能吃这亏？赶紧叫道：“师娘～”

程启铭立刻换上一副嘴脸：“错了，错了，师兄错了，明天我就去安国，晚上就给你买回来。”

师娘刚走到门口，听见王野喊她，回过头投来询问的眼神。王野听到程启铭服软了,立刻改口：“师娘，我帮你做饭，我做饭可好吃了。”

说完狗腿般的小跑过去，到了了门口扶着师娘就往厨房走。进门时还不忘了回头给程启铭一个挑衅的眼神。程启铭看向旁边的平三卓：“师父，原来没发现小师弟这么腹黑呀，这以后，咱爷俩儿还有好日子过吗？”

平三卓白了程启铭：“还有脸说呢！你都多大岁数了？连个孩子都斗不过，平时在单位你不是挺狡猾的吗？”

程启铭泄了气般：“师父，我这不是轻敌了吗，谁不觉得一个半大小子能有什么坏心眼儿呀，谁知道这小子不光有坏心眼儿，他整个心都坏了。”

平三卓一脸恨铁不成钢的表情，叹了口气进屋了。而在厨房的主力已经换成了王野，就王野现在的厨艺，做几个家常菜太容易了。

Wang Ye galloped all the way, and when he entered the courtyard of Ping Sanzhuo's house, he shouted: "Master, Master, help me, my master, and my senior brother want to beat me."

When the teacher's wife heard Wang Ye's shout, she came out wearing an apron and holding a shovel.Wang Ye quickly stepped forward and complained: "Master's wife, please save me!"

The master's wife asked anxiously: "What's going on? Tell the master's wife, and the master's wife will judge for you. He is an old thing. He doesn't want to live a good life!"

Wang Ye told the story of the matter in a more aggravating manner, and the master's wife snorted: "Humph~ Xiaoye is fine, the master's wife will make the decision for you. If the two of them come back and dare to get angry, you see how I will deal with them."

As soon as Wang Ye finished the prosecution, Ping Sanzhuo and Cheng Qiming, who had their heads tied, entered the hospital.As soon as they entered the hospital, the teacher's wife started to get angry: "Boss, I heard that you are going to use family methods? Why don't I know what other family methods you have? Come on, come on, come and take out your family methods. Let me see if it is your family methods that are stronger, or my shovel?"

Cheng Qiming couldn't figure it out now. This junior brother was not like this before. He was quite sensible when we first met him!What kind of evil is this? Why have you become so cunning?But in the face of Master's wife's questioning, Cheng Qiming could only suffer the loss of being dumb: "Master's wife, I am just trying to scare my junior brother, we are joking!"

"Are you kidding? Is this a joke? You look so scared on Xiaoye, you don't look like a senior brother at all. I think you just eat enough to hold on. When I am free one day, I have to talk to my sister-in-law from the Cheng family."

Cheng Qiming's face turned pale. Not to mention whether he could beat Wang Ye or not, it was not good to call the parents at every turn. Besides, Cheng Qiming's child was not even a few years younger than Wang Ye.If his mother gave him a beating, he wouldn't need this old face anymore.

Cheng Qiming lowered his head and held back a sentence for a long time: "Master's wife, I won't dare to do that anymore."

Ping Sanzhuo didn't say a word and was about to walk into the house. The master's wife hadn't used her majesty enough. How could he be fooled so easily: "Old man, why are you running away? I heard that you are very majestic! Xiaoye came to see you and noticed something was wrong. My child only came back yesterday afternoon and came to see you early this morning."

"Go into the house and take a look. The children are bringing you meat and ginseng, and you have chosen the right ones. I think you are just full, so you might as well cut the food in half from now on."

This is a naked threat. Ping Sanzhuo's food is not bad, but he is only about 70 to 80% full, and he may feel a little meaty in a week.This is already more than 95% of people. If this was reduced by half, the little old man would be so hungry that he would rest on the recliner every day.

Ping Sanzhuo wisely did not talk back. He knew his wife's temper too well.This little old lady can really do what she says, but by then it will be too late.Seeing that Ping Sanzhuo didn't say anything, the wife didn't continue to get angry and turned around to go back to the kitchen.

Cheng Qiming took a step forward and whispered: "Xiaoye, don't forget, you just asked me for something!"

Can Wang Ye suffer this loss?He quickly shouted: "Master's wife~"

Cheng Qiming immediately changed his face: "Wrong, wrong, senior brother, I will go to Anguo tomorrow and buy it back for you in the evening."

As soon as the master's wife walked to the door, she heard Wang Ye calling her and turned around to give her a questioning look.When Wang Ye heard that Cheng Qiming had softened, he immediately changed his mind: "Master's wife, I will help you cook. My cooking is delicious."

After saying that, he trotted over like a dog, and when he reached the door, he supported the master's wife and walked to the kitchen.When he entered, he didn't forget to turn around and give Cheng Qiming a provocative look.Cheng Qiming looked at Ping Sanzhuo next to him: "Master, I didn't realize that my junior brother is so evil. Will we have a good life after this?"

Ping Sanzhuo rolled his eyes at Cheng Qiming: "How dare you say it! How old are you? You can't even fight a child. Aren't you usually quite cunning in the workplace?"

Cheng Qiming was discouraged: "Master, am I underestimating the enemy? Who doesn't think that a young man can have any evil intentions? Who knows that this kid not only has evil intentions, but his whole heart is broken."

Ping Sanzhuo had a look of hatred on his face, sighed and entered the room.The main force in the kitchen has been replaced by Wang Ye. With Wang Ye's current cooking skills, it is too easy to make a few home-cooked dishes.
